subject: general
question: Which of the following is the least reactive element?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Neon.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**​**Neon**

__
 
• **Colorless, odorless, inert monatomic gas under standard conditions.**
 
• It has about **two-thirds the density of air.**
 
• It is used in** vacuum tubes, high-voltage indicators, lightning arresters, wavemeter tubes, television tubes, and helium–neon lasers.**
 
• **Liquefied neon** is commercially used as a **cryogenic refrigerant.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Chlorine

 
• **Yellow-green gas at room temperature.**
 
• Used in** industry and found in some household products**.
 
• Sometimes, it can be in the form of a** poisonous gas.**

**Hydrogen**

 
• **Colorless, odorless, tasteless, non-toxic, and highly combustible.**
 
• Most abundant chemical substance in the universe, **constituting approx. 75% **of all normal matter.

**Oxygen**

 
• **Highly reactive nonmetal, and an oxidizing agent.**
 
• It readily forms **oxides with most elements as well as with other compounds. **
